type_system.rule: No proof object is portable across a change in any required domain field unless it is re-certified or a theorem explicitly quantifies over that field.

STRICT_ATTRACTOR_FIXED_POINT.statement: For a finite turn-based game graph and exact target T, Attr(T) is the least fixed point containing T and closed under attacker-existential and defender-universal predecessors, under the declared shortcut semantics encoded in the graph.
STRICT_ATTRACTOR_FIXED_POINT.composition_role: Base reachability object; role-dual gives defender sanctuary attractors.

BRANCH_KERNEL_FACTORIZATION_2.status: mathematical theorem; chess-machine factorization exact; independent generic regression
BRANCH_KERNEL_FACTORIZATION_2.statement: Let A1=Attr(T1), A2=Attr(T2), B=A1∪A2 and P=Attr(T1∪T2)\B. Define K as residual defender states whose legal replies all enter B and whose replies are not contained wholly in A1 or wholly in A2. Then P is exactly the residual backward closure generated from K. Hence P is nonempty iff K is nonempty.
BRANCH_KERNEL_FACTORIZATION_2.proof_idea: Choose a minimum full-union attractor-rank state in nonempty P. It cannot be attacker-owned, because an attacker successor in a constituent basin would put it in that basin and a lower-rank pure successor contradicts minimality. It is therefore defender-owned; all lower-rank successors lie in B, and being outside each constituent requires replies escaping each constituent. This is K. Induction on union-attractor rank gives the full residual closure equality.
corollaries: Attractor subsumption A1⊆A2 or A2⊆A1 implies zero pure bridge.
Defender-controlled alternative choice is the local kernel mechanism; propagation halos are ordinary backward closure.
BRANCH_KERNEL_FACTORIZATION_2.chess_evidence: Exact across 24 same-side N/B/R file arenas, G3 strict-pure audit, opposing-minor d7/b7, and two-sided race examples.

generic_regression.note: Independent randomized regression over arbitrary finite turn-based total game graphs; supports implementation/general theorem but is not a substitute for the mathematical proof.

HYPERKERNEL_FACTORIZATION_N.status: mathematical finite-n theorem; n=3 machine-exact in chess and generic regression
HYPERKERNEL_FACTORIZATION_N.statement: For targets {Ti}_{i∈I}, define A_J=Attr(∪_{j∈J}Tj), base B=∪_{J⊊I}A_J (equivalently the union of maximal proper-subunion attractors), and irreducible H=Attr(∪_{i∈I}Ti)\B. H is exactly the residual backward closure of defender hyperkernel states whose replies all enter B but are not contained in any maximal proper-subunion attractor. Thus irreducible n-way composition is nonempty iff its hyperkernel is nonempty.
HYPERKERNEL_FACTORIZATION_N.proof_idea: The same minimum-rank argument as the two-target case forces a minimum irreducible state to be defender-owned, with all successors in the proper-subunion base and at least one successor outside each maximal proper-subunion basin. Rank induction yields factorization.
HYPERKERNEL_FACTORIZATION_N.n3_chess_evidence: Exact b-g N/B/R same-side atlas; e.g. d/e: 2,739 irreducible N states and 6,172 B states, zero R.

generic_regression.note: Independent randomized regression over arbitrary finite turn-based total game graphs; supports implementation/general theorem but is not a substitute for the mathematical proof.

ROLE_DUAL_SANCTUARY_ATTRACTOR.status: mathematical role-dual operation; one exact fortress demonstration
ROLE_DUAL_SANCTUARY_ATTRACTOR.statement: Swapping existential/universal player roles in strict reachability gives a defender sanctuary attractor with the same fixed-point semantics.

RESOURCE_SAFE_TARGET_CONSTRUCTOR.status: strong prospective schema; not asserted as universal theorem
RESOURCE_SAFE_TARGET_CONSTRUCTOR.normal_form: CORE_TARGET ∧ TERMINAL_SAFE ∧ CONVERSION_PATH_AVAILABLE ∧ OPPONENT_RACE_NONDOMINANT ∧ OPPONENT_ACCESS_OUTSIDE_RELEVANT_CONE, with guards activated only when the arena contains the corresponding resource.

instances.TARGET_SAFE: zero-counterexample same-side a-h N/B/R rank5-7 and full-rank scans after terminal-stalemate guard
instances.TARGET_NSAFE: TARGET_SAFE + enemy knight graph distance to pawn >=4; exact on opposing-minor d7 discovery, b7 and f7 heldouts
instances.TARGET_RACE_CLEAR: race target + opponent promotion slower + WK not on own promotion square; exact on BCF discovery, CDG translation heldout and ABE edge heldout
instances.TARGET_RACE_PATH_CLEAR: TARGET_RACE_CLEAR + friendly minor not on own promotion square; exact DB-N/DB-B discovery, translated CE N/B, OOD BE N/B, and DB-R original

RESOURCE_SAFE_TARGET_CONSTRUCTOR.interpretation: G5's geometric target was not universally wrong; it was an under-typed target whose validity depends on whether terminal, access, race and conversion resources can invalidate the intended semantic conversion.

LOCALIZATION_LIFT.status: methodological diagnostic, not a chess theorem
LOCALIZATION_LIFT.definition: lift = fraction(mixed residual geometries in slab) − fraction(all residual geometries in slab)
LOCALIZATION_LIFT.rule: Raw slab coverage is insufficient evidence of a critical manifold when the slab also covers nearly all residual geometry. No universal numeric threshold is claimed.

representation_regimes.SELECTIVE_MANIFOLD: Opposing-minor and faithful fortress: large positive localization lift, then small off-surface tail.
representation_regimes.SATURATED_CLOCKS: Dense two-sided races and double-brink: raw race-slab coverage near/at 100% but lift near zero, so the surface is not discriminative.
representation_regimes.TRANSFERABLE_LOCAL_GRAMMAR: Double-brink off-contact tail: 10-leaf exact grammar, no piece-type atom, exact on 133,699 non-vacuous held-out states.
representation_regimes.COMPACT_BUT_NOT_THEOREM_TRANSFER: Opposing-minor tail: compact grammar, ~99.7% held-out accuracy, but preserved counterexamples prevent theorem promotion.
representation_regimes.LOOKUP_SCALE_FLOOR: Historical G4/G5 tails: exact leaf/geometry cost near or above predeclared lookup threshold; STOP rather than square patching.

TERMINAL_SEMANTICS_IS_TYPED.status: proof-system requirement demonstrated by exact counterfactual
TERMINAL_SEMANTICS_IS_TYPED.statement: Terminal semantics are part of the game graph and therefore part of every proof object's domain. A proof object cannot be transferred across changed terminal semantics without re-certification.
